hero.title: A better place
hero.description: Discover, play, and tune every detail without leaving the story.
hero.imageAlt: Framezoo desktop app showing the discovery screen

features.experienceTitle: Everything you need for a better watch.
features.overviewDescription: AI subtitle sync, dual subtitles, rich title context, and a player that stays out of the way.
features.subtitleSyncDescription: Line up the opening dialogue with the picture in seconds.
features.dualSubtitlesDescription: Switch on dual subtitles when you are learning, comparing, or simply prefer both.
features.subtitleControlsDescription: Choose subtitle source, language, timing, and display without breaking your flow.
features.ecosystemTitle: The essentials live in the player.
features.ecosystemDescription: Subtitles, catalog metadata, and playback controls are built in. Addons extend the edges with more sources and catalogs when you need them.
features.showcaseDescription: Open a title and get the story around it: artwork, ratings, seasons, and metadata in one place.
features.showcasePrimaryAlt: Framezoo title detail screen with artwork, ratings, seasons, and metadata
features.showcaseSecondaryDescription: Start from a clean discovery surface, then move into playback without losing your place.
features.showcaseSecondaryAlt: Framezoo discovery screen with search, categories, and title rows

addonGuide.title: Add a source without rebuilding the player.
addonGuide.description: An addon is a small HTTP service. Provide the resources you need; Framezoo handles the rest.
addonGuide.manifestDescription: Your manifest gives the app a name, supported resources, and a home for its icon.
addonGuide.resourcesDescription: Implement only the endpoints your addon needs. Responses are JSON and can be written in any language.

resources.catalog: Rows of movies or series for discovery.
resources.meta: Movie or series metadata for a title.
resources.stream: Torrent, HLS, DASH, or direct file sources.

addonGuide.runTitle: Run it, test it, install it.
steps: Serve /manifest.json and your resource endpoints from a local or public HTTP(S) server.
Test each endpoint with curl and verify the JSON shape.
Paste the manifest URL into Framezoo > Addons.
addonGuide.advancedDescription: The Stremio Addon SDK is optional. Use it for routing and serialization helpers; the protocol does not require it.
